scenarios.name: basic-call-liveness
scenarios.description: Verify call connects and AI responds to a simple greeting

utterances.text: Hey, I had a really good day today.

scenarios.name: multi-turn-daily-call
scenarios.description: Two-turn conversation to verify turn-taking works

utterances.text: I had a productive day at work today. I finished the new feature.
Yeah, it was the voice recording feature. Took about three days.

scenarios.name: tool-call-save-entry
scenarios.description: Verify AI invokes save_entry during conversation

utterances.text: I want to save a note. Today I went for a long run in the park and it felt amazing.

scenarios.name: voice-note-basic
scenarios.description: Verify voice note captures transcript via speech_to_text

utterances.text: Today I went grocery shopping and cooked a nice dinner.

scenarios.name: multi-item-fifa-mixed-sentiment
scenarios.description: S1 (FIFA regression): one breath mixing a disliked subscription with gratitude for participating. Expect 2 save_entry calls: 1 negative (the unwanted subscription) + 1 gratitude-or-positive (happy to participate in FIFA). Regression for multi-item utterances collapsing into a single entry.

utterances.text: I paid for a subscription which I don't like, but I had to for the FIFA, and I'm happy I'm participating in FIFA.

scenarios.name: multi-item-incomplete-trailing-thought
scenarios.description: S2 (incomplete utterance): speaker trails off mid-sentence. Expect at least 1 save_entry: the mom call (positive/gratitude). The dangling clause must not block extraction of the completed item.

utterances.text: Work was, yeah. And then my mom called and that was actually really nice but Iâ€”

scenarios.name: multi-item-straying-three-topics
scenarios.description: S3 (straying across topics): three distinct items in one breath. Expect 3 save_entry calls: beauty (the sunset) + negative-or-identity (forgot to email Sarah) + positive (proud finishing the run).

utterances.text: The sunset was unreal. Oh and I forgot to email Sarah. Anyway I felt proud finishing the run.

scenarios.name: single-item-good-day
scenarios.description: S4 (single item control): a single positive statement must produce exactly 1 save_entry (positive), never split into multiple. Guards against over-segmentation.

utterances.text: Today was just a good day.

scenarios.name: multi-item-two-framings-promotion
scenarios.description: S5 (two framings of one event): the same event carries opposing sentiment. Expect 2 save_entry calls: positive/identity (the promotion worked hard for) + negative (terrified of the responsibility).

utterances.text: My promotion, I worked so hard for it but now I'm terrified of the responsibility.

scenarios.name: no-item-liveness-check
scenarios.description: S9 (no journalable content): a connectivity check with no reflective content. Expect 0 save_entry calls â€” the AI should respond conversationally but save nothing. Guards against hallucinated entries.

utterances.text: Um, can you hear me? Is this thing working?

scenarios.name: negation-not-grateful-traffic
scenarios.description: S10 (negation handling): negated gratitude must be categorized by actual sentiment, not surface keyword. Expect 1 save_entry: negative (the traffic). Must NOT classify as gratitude despite the word 'grateful'.

utterances.text: I was not grateful for the traffic, let me tell you.

scenarios.name: multi-item-run-on-five-plus
scenarios.description: S11 (run-on, many items): a single breath packing 5+ distinct items across categories. Expect at least 5 save_entry calls: positive (raise), gratitude (mentor lunch), beauty (cherry blossoms), negative (missed train), identity (felt like a real engineer).

utterances.text: So today I got a raise, and my mentor took me to lunch which I'm really thankful for, and on the walk back the cherry blossoms were absolutely stunning, but then I missed my train home, and honestly for the first time I felt like a real engineer.

scenarios.name: self-correction-final-state
scenarios.description: S12 (self-correction): speaker corrects their own framing mid-sentence. Expect 1 save_entry: positive (the corrected final state â€” it ended well), not negative. Guards against capturing the retracted framing.

utterances.text: It was a bad day, no actually, it ended well.
